description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 12.03.2018 to 18.03.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that modifies how customs regulations are applied, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" category for statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks.
